title: Immunization — WHO/EPI baseline schedule (draft)
summary: WHO Expanded Programme on Immunization (EPI) baseline routine schedule. National schedules vary (antigens, timing, conditional antigens like yellow fever/MenA) and MUST be authored as national overlays — this baseline is the WHO-recommended reference. DRAFT — clinician verification required before approval.
principles: Give all due antigens at a visit; do not miss opportunities to vaccinate.
Minimum intervals between doses must be respected; resume (do not restart) interrupted schedules.
Check and record on the national immunization card / registry.
nationalOverlayNotes: Per-country overlays MUST replace this with the national EPI schedule (antigens, exact timing, conditional antigens, catch-up).
